decisions: Parsed Date (dd/mm/yyyy) + Time (HH.MM.SS) into a datetime; rows that fail are dropped.
Replaced the -200 missing-value sentinel with NaN (it is not a real measurement).
Dropped rows whose target is missing. Missing FEATURE values are kept and imputed inside the pipeline (training-set medians).
IQR outliers are reported but NOT removed (extreme pollution episodes are legitimate).

excluded_columns.CO(GT): Reference-analyser ground truth; the goal is estimation from cheap sensors.
excluded_columns.NMHC(GT): Reference analyser; ~90% missing in this file.
excluded_columns.NOx(GT): Reference analyser; not available from a low-cost sensor array.
excluded_columns.NO2(GT): Reference analyser; not available from a low-cost sensor array.
excluded_columns.AH: Absolute humidity is derived from T and RH (redundant).
